settings.heading: The right yak chew for your Husky.
settings.subheading: Huskies are high-energy, strong-jawed chewers who destroy most toys in minutes. They need a dense, durable chew that channels their energy into calm-time enrichment.
settings.estimate_note: Huskies (35–60 lbs) are strong chewers. Most need a Large. If your Husky finishes a Large in under 30 minutes, size up to XL.
settings.card_1_text: Most Huskies weigh 35–60 lbs but chew like much larger dogs. Start with a Large and observe. If they finish it in one session, move to XL for longer enrichment.
settings.card_2_text: Huskies are bred to run all day. When they cannot run, they chew — furniture, shoes, drywall. A yak chew gives them an appropriate outlet that satisfies their need to work.
settings.card_3_title: Pair with exercise for best results
settings.card_3_text: Give the yak chew after a walk or play session. A tired Husky plus a yak chew equals 30–90 minutes of calm. This combination is the most effective way to prevent destructive behavior.
